crossRefs.note: “They are amazed. They answer no more. They don’t have a word to say.
Shall I wait, because they don’t speak, because they stand still, and answer no more?
Mark well, Job, and listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will speak.
so he will cleanse many nations. Kings will shut their mouths at him; for they will see that which had not been told…
No one was able to answer him a word, neither did any man dare ask him any more questions from that day forward.
My doctrine will drop as the rain. My speech will condense as the dew, as the misty rain on the tender grass, as the…
Your lips, my bride, drip like the honeycomb. Honey and milk are under your tongue. The smell of your garments is like…
“Son of man, set your face toward the south, and preach toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the field…
Now therefore listen to Yahweh’s word: ‘You say, Don’t prophesy against Israel, and don’t preach against the house of…
“Don’t prophesy!” They prophesy. “Don’t prophesy about these things. Disgrace won’t overtake us.”

translations.web: After my words they didn’t speak again. My speech fell on them.
translations.bsb: After my words, they spoke no more; my speech settled on them like dew.
translations.kjv: After my words they spake not again; and my speech dropped
translations.asv: After my words they spake not again; And my speech distilled upon them.
